authors.bio: Wendy Aylsworth Aylsworth is vice president of technology for Warner Bros. Technical Operations, where she oversees the establishment of new technologies for Warner Bros, production divisions and assesses the impact of emerging technologies on production and distribution. She participates in standards organizations to promote commonality for the benefit of the entertainment sector. Aylsworth's current focus is the worldwide development and adoption of D-Cinema standards, for which she is Chairman of the SMPTE DC28 Technical Committee on D-Cinema. She is also honored to be a SMPTE Fellow and to have recently received the ShoWest D-Cinema Pioneers Award. Aylsworth joined Warner Bros. in 1994, establishing the sophisticated technology operations for a newly created Feature Animation division. Previously, she spent five years at Disney, overseeing animation technology and theme park rides software development. She spent 15 years in aerospace, developing systems for operational aircraft and training simulators. Her private interests have resulted in her chairing several educational and financial Boards. Aylsworth holds an MS/MBA (Beta Gamma Sigma) in strategic planning from the University of Southern California and a BS in computer engineering sciences from the University of Michigan.
